admission.justification: Verifying reached artifact before replay prevents altered file or report link substituting another first assignment.

applicability: Unresolved saved launch with receipt and artifact reference.
conditions: Every refusal is decided before either file is written, so a refused retry leaves both as they were.
exclusions: A new compilation or request is not an answer to this saved unresolved launch.
Successor and step-up starts compile a new hand-over and write new files.
statement: A saved first message is sent only after both of its files were checked: files that hold the saved text are left untouched, a lost file is written again from the receipt's own text alone (read-only, and only at the place its reference's own path leads to), and a changed file, a saved text that does not match its reference, a saved message that does not name the recorded complete hand-over, or a path that no longer leads to the recorded file refuses the retry with a refusal that says what to put right, with receipt and files untouched. A receipt that records no complete hand-over is restored by the text file's rules alone.
